engines.name: Meterless H-MEM
engines.role: memory engine: the claim graph is an H-MEM memory spine (claims as memories, dedupe for echoes, supersedes for updates, append-only trust ledger)
engines.integration: vendored from github.com/Meterless/Meterless engines/hmem/reference (Apache-2.0) at vendor/hmem; Meterless's own conformance suite at vendor/hmem-conformance passes 13/13 via npm run conformance

engines.name: Nebius Token Factory
engines.role: live LLM inference: Qwen3-30B claim extraction and Nemotron relation judging, gated by a deterministic verbatim-quote verifier; every call logged in logs/model-ledger.jsonl
engines.integration: src/models/nebius.ts (OpenAI-compatible client, startup /models discovery guards against model churn), orchestrated by src/orchestrator/liveExtract.ts and liveJudge.ts; activated with --live or MODE=LIVE

engines.name: Zetaris AI Data Gateway
engines.role: SQL evidence mart federating registry, filing and issuer sources behind one query interface
engines.integration: src/connectors/zetaris.ts; live path VERIFIED 2026-10-23 against the local gateway (Basic login -> idToken, POST /api/v1.0/query/sql/start, 9/9 mart rows through api->driver->Spark; raw capture samples/06-zetaris-live.txt); honest SAMPLE export remains the default and is provenance-tagged

engines.name: Tavily
engines.role: capture-time extraction of issuer IR releases through WAF-blocked IR pages (frozen into the hash-manifested fixture)
engines.integration: used at fixture-capture time; no runtime dependency - frozen bytes verified via fixtures/zura-2026-10-22/manifest.json sha256

declarations.pre_existing_work: product spec and connector design in docs/spec/ predate the 22.10 build window and are declared in the submission
declarations.ai_assistance: built with AI coding assistance; all model-proposed claims pass a deterministic verifier before entering the graph
declarations.synthetic_data: fixture documents marked synthetic:true in fixtures/zura-2026-10-22/manifest.json are synthetic (older registry snapshot, 3 echo pages); all other fixture bytes are real captures from 2026-10-22
